title: Pirá: A Bilingual Portuguese-English Dataset for Question-Answering about the Ocean

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of bilingual QA pairs, identifying that questions authored by native Portuguese speakers tend to be better formulated in Portuguese than in their English translations (referred to by the authors as 'Portuguese-bias').

Manual assessment and paraphrasing of questions by independent annotators during dataset creation to reduce word co-occurrence between source texts and QA pairs, actively mitigating simple word-matching heuristics in reading comprehension models.
